recognize_zh: 多格組圖中，嗜中性球（A–F、H）與一顆嗜酸性球（K）胞質內可見被透明暈圈包住的短桿菌，G、I、J 另見血片背景中成群的游離桿菌；周邊血抹片直接看到細菌，提示高菌量菌血症（本例為 Klebsiella pneumoniae）。
features: Composite of peripheral blood fields (panels A-K), MGG stain, oil immersion
Neutrophils containing short, plump bacilli within clear phagocytic vacuoles; the clear halo suggests a capsule (panels A-F, H)
One eosinophil with coarse orange granules also contains an intracytoplasmic bacillus (panel K)
Extracellular clusters of short basophilic rods lying free among red cells (panels G, I, J)
Neutrophil cytoplasm shows vacuolization; red cells and platelets otherwise unremarkable in these fields
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (composite of high-power fields) shows neutrophils containing short, plump rod-shaped bacteria within clear phagocytic vacuoles, with a surrounding clear halo suggestive of a capsule. A similar intracytoplasmic bacillus is seen within an eosinophil. In addition, small clusters of extracellular bacilli are present between red cells, favoring true bacteremia over contamination introduced during slide preparation when correlated with cultures. Species cannot be determined morphologically; the findings indicate a very high burden of bacteremia with gram-negative-appearing bacilli, consistent with the blood-culture isolate of Klebsiella pneumoniae.

ddx.vs: Precipitate is irregular, lies on top of cells in multiple planes, and lacks the uniform rod shape and intravacuolar location with a halo seen here.
Döhle bodies are pale blue, ill-defined peripheral cytoplasmic patches and toxic vacuoles are empty, whereas here discrete dark rods sit inside the vacuoles.
Morulae are mulberry-like clusters of tiny cocci within a membrane-bound inclusion, not individual encapsulated bacilli, and bacteria are not seen extracellularly.

ddx.dx: Contamination of the specimen or slide
ddx.vs: Contaminant bacteria are usually only extracellular; intracellular phagocytosed organisms with a matching positive blood culture support true bacteremia.
